tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and irregular raw prefixes support a coupled memory-kernel mechanism, but five observations leave its parameters insufficiently identified. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to fit and test it.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows do not adequately identify its four coupled parameters; the archived mechanism specifies at least eight rows.
The observed history gap and transient lag point to memory dynamics rather than a static sink-gradient branch.
It does not resolve the memory-ODE identifiability ambiguity.
